confirms: the lead raised by E1_I0023 / D098 and RAISED-AND-NOT-ACCEPTED by the coordinator
question: Is the top-tercile opponent-defence gain a THRESHOLD (genuinely concentrated in high-volume players, non-linear in volume, representable by a pooled step) or a REFIT ARTEFACT (the top tercile simply has different baseline relationships, so re-estimating every coefficient there improves fit regardless of defence)?

partition.note: 2021 is a TRAINING fold only. 2025/2026 never read, joined, plotted or described. Enforced on VALUES by D098's assert_partition inside every load.

reference.why: reference incompleteness is this programme's top-ranked source of false results and the same cell moved 6.66x between a single-column and a complete reference IN THE SCREEN BEING CONFIRMED. Every available strictly-prior measurement of the target is in the base of BOTH arms of EVERY rung.

tier_construction: tercile cut points on the player's strictly-prior usage per game, computed on the FIRST TRAINING FOLD (2021) only and applied forward, so a tier label could genuinely have been attached before tip-off. D098's `s07.tiers_for`, called unchanged.
scored_rows: EVERY rung is scored on the IDENTICAL walk-forward top-tercile rows (D098's 1,687 on ppm/DECISION), with SST taken on those rows, which is D098's dR2 definition. Fold gating is D098's (tier training >= 300, tier test >= 80).

ladder.fit: POOLED (all decision-stratum training rows, all tiers)
ladder.why: one pooled defence coefficient. The floor of the ladder.
D098's interaction, scored as a FAMILY against a no-defence base so it is on the same footing as L3 and L4. A linear interaction cannot represent a step in volume.

ladder.arm_B: [1, COMPLETE reference (5), prior usage, tier dummies D2, D3]
ladder.arm_A: arm_B + defence + D2 x (defence - d_bar) + D3 x (defence - d_bar)
ladder.why: THE DECISIVE TEST. One model, all rows, a STEP FUNCTION in volume for the defence slope. This is exactly what the THRESHOLD reading claims exists and what D098 named and did not run.

ladder.fit: TIER-RESTRICTED (top-tercile training rows only) -- D098's construction
ladder.why: D098's +0.023863. Reproduced here as the anchor and as the top of the ladder.

decomposition.what: no-defence base fitted POOLED vs the SAME no-defence base fitted TIER-RESTRICTED, scored on the identical top-tercile rows. NO DEFENCE COLUMN IN EITHER ARM.
decomposition.why: THE SINGLE CLEANEST MEASUREMENT OF THE ARTEFACT HYPOTHESIS. Whatever this recovers is the refit's own contribution, with the defence term absent by construction.

decomposition.what: freeze the tier-restricted model's NON-DEFENCE coefficients, then fit only a defence coefficient on the frozen model's training residual (centred defence, no free intercept).
decomposition.why: does the defence term still earn its keep when it may not re-shuffle the others?

decomposition.what: same, but the frozen non-defence coefficients come from the POOLED fit.
decomposition.why: does defence earn its keep with NO tier refit anywhere?

placebos.what: the identical L4 machinery on the MIDDLE and BOTTOM terciles
placebos.why: if a big gain appears there too, the gain is about refitting a subset.

placebos.what: tier labels permuted among masked rows WITHIN SEASON, 500 draws, L4 statistic recomputed in full inside every draw
placebos.why: the null distribution for 'refitting any 1,687 rows'.

placebos.what: tiers assigned to WHOLE PLAYER-SEASON BLOCKS at random, size-matched, 500 draws
placebos.why: a row shuffle breaks the player-block structure and could make the null too easy; this keeps whole player-seasons together.

placebos.what: the whole ladder and the whole decomposition with G01_noise in place of the defence column
placebos.why: does the machinery manufacture an increment from nothing?

placebos.what: the within-date opponent-swap null code path executed with the UNPERMUTED defence column; must return the observed dR2 to 0.
placebos.why: plumbing check. A vacuous control has bitten this programme twice, so the swap null is ALSO required to demonstrate that it actually perturbs: the mean fraction of team-game units whose defence value changes under a real draw, and corr(original, swapped), are both reported and the fraction must exceed 0.5.

nulls.what: permute the defence value among the team-games played on the SAME date; the whole walk-forward fit is redone inside every draw. 500 draws, seed 20260808.
nulls.status: THE HEADLINE NULL. It is D098's, so the numbers are comparable, and it is the correct level for a between-opponent question: it preserves the date's marginal distribution of defence exactly and destroys only WHICH opponent was faced. It also holds the refit fixed while permuting the defence column, which is precisely the contrast this screen needs.

nulls.what: flip the sign of every row's paired squared-error difference inside a whole opponent-team-season. 2000 draws.
nulls.status: reported alongside, at the level the defence term varies at.
CONTRAST ONLY, known anticonservative (D098 measured a median width inflation of 1.611). Never a verdict.
NOT USED. Anticonservative for autocorrelated regressors; the cyclic variant is the honest one and is not needed here because no per-player slope is estimated.

decision_rule.primary_statistic: L3_pooled_tier_dummy_x_defence, response ppm, DECISION stratum, COMPLETE reference, walk-forward, scored on the SAME 1,687 top-tercile rows D098 scored, dR2 against the rung's own no-defence arm.
THRESHOLD_if: the negative control does not improve anything (one-sided p >= 0.05)
REFIT_ARTEFACT_if_any_of: R_nodef >= G_refit  -- refitting with no defence column at all buys as much as the defence term is credited with
Q95_rand >= 0.60 * G_refit  -- refitting a random equally sized subset reproduces it
the random-tier one-sided p for the real top tercile is >= 0.05
F <= 0.15 AND Q95_rand >= 0.30 * G_refit  -- the gain is not representable without the full tier refit, and refitting subsets is worth a material fraction of it
decision_rule.UNRESOLVED_otherwise: state exactly which criterion failed and what would settle it. In particular F <= 0.15 with a clean random-tier null means the gain is REAL BUT NOT A STEP IN THE DEFENCE SLOPE -- it requires tier-specific baseline coefficients -- and that is reported as its own outcome, not silently folded into either verdict.
decision_rule.reproduction_gate: |reproduced - published| < 1e-9 on BOTH of D098's anchors (+0.023862917871899772 ppm and +0.018702810112816066 points). IF THIS FAILS THE SCREEN STOPS AND REPORTS, because everything downstream is meaningless otherwise.
decision_rule.axis_resolution_rule: the axis is DECLARED SEPARABLE only if the defence gain is present on one axis's top tercile and absent (< 0.30 x) on another's, measured on the DISAGREEMENT rows where the two axes' top terciles differ. If the disagreement sets are too small or all axes carry it, the honest answer is COLLINEAR AND NOT SEPARABLE, and that is reported as the result rather than as a failure.
